summary: Iteration 14: Tested all school selection features. BNPS test user was missing from MongoDB (needed re-seeding). After seeding, all 11 backend tests pass. Frontend: Sign Up tab shows school selector cards, Coming Soon badge on NPS, amber permanent-selection warning, school validation error works. BNPS student login works. ProfilePage shows 'Brooklyn National Public School' with contact admin note. All features verified.
action_items: IMPORTANT: The BNPS test user (bnps@student.edu) was NOT in MongoDB — it had to be re-seeded. E1 should ensure the seed script is idempotent and runs on deploy, or the user is seeded in server.py startup. The user was lost between iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: BNPS test user not persisted — seed data is ephemeral. Server restart or DB reset removes it. Consider adding seeding to server.py startup or a persistent seed script.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 tests pass after seeding BNPS user)
